responsibility: Declares Rust frontend tree-language helpers, macros, flags, and utility interfaces that adapt GCC tree internals for Rust backend use. It defines predicates and layout flags for references, slices, closures, scalar and class-like types, tree-walking and vector helpers, location and rvalue utilities, and the exported constant-evaluation/type-check helper declarations consumed throughout rust/backend lowering.
same_name_distinction: Serves as the declaration and macro header for Rust tree support, defining tree-language flags, predicates, inline helpers, and exported function prototypes consumed across rust/backend; unlike rust-tree.cc, it does not contain the concrete implementations of the tree-manipulation and diagnostic routines or the global tree-state definitions.
